name: Devot
subtitle: Local-first Markdown notes
promotionalText: Markdown notes that stay on your iPhone and iPad. Live preview, notebooks, tags and on-device search. Encrypted sync. A 30-day trial, then Devot Pro, bought once.
description:
Devot is a local-first Markdown notes app for iPhone and iPad.

Notes stay in a SQLite database on the device. Writing, organising and searching work offline, with no Devot account. English and Simplified Chinese.

The editor has a live preview for GitHub-flavoured Markdown, code, math and diagrams. Tables are edited from the keyboard. Notebooks nest, tags have colours, and a note can be pinned or given a status.

Search covers the note text and words in attached images, on the device. Link notes and see backlinks. On iPad the same screens use columns when the window is wide.

Sync with a Mac is end-to-end encrypted, through iCloud or a relay you run.

A 30-day trial unlocks every feature. Devot Pro is a one-time in-app purchase and keeps working in later versions. A licence key unlocks the app on up to three devices at a time. After the trial, notes can still be read, searched by keyword, copied and exported.
